chapters.caption: The same plate, now on six 3 x 3 mm support pillars
Layer at z 2 mm: every pillar is filled with support hatch (dark grey)
Meander: 0.2 mm apart, right up to the pillar outline
Solid supports: no border, only an inset and a hatch
Offset draws rings parallel to the outline
After: smaller hatch areas, 120 mm of lines instead of 270 mm
Each pillar: 0.5 mm free at the edge, five offset rings inside
Toolpaths in 3D up to the plate
